_comment: Per-VST default control maps. Keys are exact plugin names as FL reports them. Two formats supported: a flat entry ({'knob': [...], 'slider': [...]}), or a multi-page entry ({'pages': [{'name': ..., 'knob': [...], 'slider': [...]}, ...]}) whose pages are cycled with the Left/Right nav buttons while the plugin is focused. Parameter names must match what appears in vst_param_scans/<plugin>.json. Any slot left null/missing falls through to the automatic mapper. Re-read on every patch commit - no script reload needed.

_example_multi_page_sampler_TEMPLATE._note: UNVERIFIED TEMPLATE. FL's Sampler parameter names have not been confirmed against a real scan - load a Sampler, let the auto-mapper run, then open vst_param_scans/Sampler.json and correct these names to match exactly. Rename this key to the exact plugin name FL reports (likely 'Sampler') to activate it.
